items.title: AI 3D产业路线首次公开讨论：Hi3D闭门会释放哪些新趋势？
items.raw_excerpt: 深圳，7月23日——Hi3D实体创意生态闭门会在深圳举行。围绕“探索AI驱动的下一代可制造生态”，Hi3D与3D打印硬件、制造、创作者及Maker领域嘉宾共同探讨AI 3D从数字生成走向实体制造的新趋势。 这也是数美万物创始人兼CEO任利锋创业后首次代表Hi3D 面向媒体、设备厂商及产业伙伴系统分享Hi3D过去一年的技术进展与产业思考。数美万物联合创始人兼算法负责人贾荣飞也在现场分享了过去一年Hi3D在算法模型优化上，里程碑式的进步。 现场，Hi3D公布了即将上线的新一代 Hi3D 3.0 2048³ 模型，定义新一代3D通用大模型SOTA。并首次系统阐述其“实体创意生态”布局：AI 3D正在从单纯的模型生成工具，进一步连接创意、模型、设备、材料和制造，让数字世界里的想法真正进入物理世界。 从“表达普惠”走向“创造普惠” “我们坚信，技术应该服务于人的创造欲与表达欲。” 任利锋表示，过去互联网通过文字、图片和短视频不断降低内容表达门槛，而AI与桌面制造技术的发展，让AI 3D用户在两年间翻了九倍，推动下一轮变化从数字世界进入物理世界。 Hi3D希望推动的是从“表达普惠”走向“创造普惠”——让普通用户不需要掌握复杂的3D建模技能，也能够把一个想法、一张图片甚至一段灵感，转化为可打印、可制造的真实物品。 过去一年，Hi3D也在持续补齐“从生成到制造”的关键环节，包括智能拆件、连接件生成、多色打印适配、模型修复等能力。相关功能上线后，平台模型下载率从49%提升至60%，打印后作品分享率从6.5%提升至9.5%。 此外，Hi3D 还展示了多项前沿技术突破:视频生 3D 让用户用手机环绕拍摄一段普通视频即可重建高精 3D 模型,已在文物修复、电商展示、家居复原等场景实现落地； AI to CAD 参数化建模可直接输出 B-rep 参数化模型与 STEP 文件,让 AI 生成结果第一次

excerpt_i18n.en: Shenzhen, July 23 — The Hi3D Entity Creative Ecosystem closed-door meeting was held in Shenzhen. Centered around "Exploring the Next-Generation Manufacturable Ecosystem Driven by AI," Hi3D, together with guests from the 3D printing hardware, manufacturing, creator, and maker communities, discussed the new trend of AI 3D moving from digital generation to physical manufacturing. This also marked the first time Ren Lifeng, founder and CEO of Shumei Wanwu, publicly represented Hi3D to systematically share the company’s technical progress and industry insights over the past year with media, device manufacturers, and industry partners. Jia Rongfei, co-founder and head of algorithms at Shumei Wanwu, also shared the milestone advancements in algorithm model optimization achieved by Hi3D over the past year. At the event, Hi3D announced the upcoming next-generation Hi3D 3.0 2048³ model, defining a new SOTA for next-generation 3D general-purpose large models. It also systematically outlined its "Entity Creative Ecosystem" strategy for the first time: AI 3D is evolving from a purely model-generation tool to connecting creativity, models, devices, materials, and manufacturing, enabling ideas from the digital world to truly enter the physical world. From "Expressive Inclusivity" to "Creative Inclusivity" "We firmly believe that technology should serve people’s desire to create and express," said Ren Lifeng. In the past, the internet has continuously lowered the barrier to content expression through text, images, and short videos. Now, the development of AI and desktop manufacturing technologies has tripled the number of AI 3D users in just two years, driving the next wave of transformation from the digital world into the physical world. Hi3D aims to advance from "Expressive Inclusivity" to "Creative Inclusivity."
excerpt_i18n.es: Shenzhen, 23 de julio — La reunión a puerta cerrada del ecosistema de creación física Hi3D se celebró en Shenzhen. En torno al tema "Explorando el ecosistema de fabricación de próxima generación impulsado por IA", Hi3D y los invitados del sector del hardware de impresión 3D, fabricación, creadores y makers debatieron la nueva tendencia de la IA 3D que pasa de la generación digital a la fabricación física. Esta fue también la primera vez que Ren Lifeng, fundador y CEO de Shumei Wanwu, representó a Hi3D tras emprender su negocio, compartiendo sistemáticamente con los medios, fabricantes de equipos y socios industriales los avances tecnológicos y reflexiones industriales de Hi3D durante el año pasado. Jia Rongfei, cofundador y responsable de algoritmos de Shumei Wanwu, también compartió en el acto los hitos alcanzados en la optimización de modelos algorítmicos de Hi3D durante el último año.
